slides.title: Hypothetical situations
slides.subtitle: Talking about imaginary situations
goals: Use the second conditional to imagine.

items.en: If you could live anywhere, where would you live?
I'd live in Vancouver because I love nature.
If you found a wallet, what would you do?
I'd take it to the police.
Imagine you were the president for a day…

items.t: If I ___ a superpower, I would fly. (have)
What would you do if you ___ a million pesos? (win)

items.q: If I ___ you, I would accept the offer.
Where ___ you go if you had a free ticket?
